policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: G NVIDIA-linked valuation dispute surfaces
items.summary: A public G complaint alleges a $350M Series A at an implied $3.5B valuation (Aug 17, 2026) and criticizes prior valuation methodology, with NVIDIA participation referenced.

items.headline: O faces CA lawsuit
items.summary: California AG sued O alleging it misled users and built advanced models without sufficient safeguards; suit seeks court-ordered changes.

items.headline: O SEC Form D filed
items.summary: O filed a Form D (exempt offering notice) with the SEC on 2026-11-12, indicating a recent securities offering activity tied to “O SPV”.

items.headline: O expands Oracle apps on ChatGPT
items.summary: O announced expanded partnership with G Oracle to bring Oracle business apps into ChatGPT, alongside Oracle app-building workflows.
